text:
emma-sales: Quick kickoff for Aurora Bank POC. Needs streaming with SSE fallback, tool/function calls, structured JSON output, on-prem connector (VPC), SAML SSO, and offline KMS. Also want a ballpark cost for 250 qps baseline, spikes to 900.

liam-eng: Noted. Which SDKs? They said Go edge proxy + Node orchestration.

emma-sales: Yep. Go on edge, Node backend. Ephemeral creds required for edge agents.

zoe-ml: For streaming recommend WS primary, SSE fallback. We can stream partial tool-call frames so UI renders incrementally. Sample frame:```json {"type":"tool.part","id":"t-9","payload":{"name":"acct_get","partial":"{\"id\":\"...\"}"}}```

liam-eng: Ephemeral header example (Go):```go req.Header.Set("Authorization", fmt.Sprintf("Bearer %s", token)) req.Header.Set("X-Req-ID", id)``` Rotate tokens ~5m.

infra-bot: If sustained >500 qps, recommend Dedicated. Hosted can handle bursts but costs more. See /pricing/dedicated for estimator.

emma-sales: Need checklist of blockers and docs to hand customer: allowlist IPs, SAML metadata flow, ephemeral token examples, KMS test plan, and a short acceptance prompt set.

liam-eng: Blockers: 1) IP allowlist or VPN, 2) SAML metadata exchange, 3) test HSM/KMS creds or connector access, 4) acceptance prompts + basic perf targets. I'll drop allowlist + Go snippets by EOD.

zoe-ml: I'll provide structured-output schema example and small eval prompts that fail on malformed tool-calls. Also sharing SOC2 summary and contact.

emma-sales: Perfect. Aiming to send one-pager to customer tomorrow and target POC start in 10-14 days pending network/SAML. :calendar: :thumbsup:

[thread end]
